title: A linked entry keeps its own category
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CATKEEP-01) is stocked at {Location-B} only, with Category {Category-A} (for example HD-Filters).
  • {Location-A} stocks no part numbered {Part-A}.
  • {Category-B} (for example Uncategorized) is a different category from {Category-A}.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a Description (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Cat Keep).
  3. Type {Part-A} in Part Number, exactly as written down.
  4. Open Category and pick {Category-B}.
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the part is saved and the window closes.
  • Step 7: the one {Part-A} row still shows Category {Category-A}, not {Category-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R6c, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Number and description typed), board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R6c: “A linked entry keeps its own category. The category picked in the dialog does not change it.”
